data.titulo: Foa 8—Mɔɔ Baebolo Ne Ka La Ba Nuhua
data.contenido:
Baebolo ne ɛnga nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ zile tete ne la angomekye anwo edwɛkɛ na eza ɔka mɔɔ bazi kenlebie la anwo edwɛkɛ. Alesama ɛngola ɛnga mɔɔ bazi kenlebie la. Ɛhye ati a yɛze kɛ Baebolo ne vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la. Duzu a Baebolo ne ka fane kenlebie anwo a?

Ɔka Nyamenle konle kpole bie anwo edwɛkɛ. Wɔ konle ɛhye anu Nyamenle baye ɛtaneyɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti nee menli ɛtane avi azɛlɛ ne azo, noko ɔbabɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la anwo bane. Nyamenle belemgbunli ne, mɔɔ yemɔ a le Gyisɛse Kelaese la, banlea anwu ye kɛ Nyamenle azonvolɛ bɛanyia anzondwolɛ nee anyelielɛ, na bɛ nwo ɛnrɛdo bɛ bieko anzɛɛ bɛnrɛwu.

Yɛ nye kola die kɛ Nyamenle bayɛ paladaese fofolɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo a, ɔnle zɔ ɔ? Noko saa yɛbadɛnla paladaese ɛhye anu a ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ nwolɛ debie. Wɔ buluku ne ɛzukoalɛdeɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ la anu yɛnwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ na yɛ sa aha nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle bayɛ amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la. Yemɔti kenga Foa MƆTWƐ ne na nwu mɔɔ Baebolo ne ka fane kenlebie anwo la.

DUZU a ɛnwu ye wɔ ɛke a? Ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dede mgbɔnwɔ fufule zo la ɔ. Noko yɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛvi bɛlɛba la nzonlɛ. Mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ lɛ ɛnriandilɛ vi anwuma a bɛlua amungu ne anu bɛlɛba a! Asoo mgbɔnwɔ amgba wɔ anwuma ɔ?

Kyɛkyɛ, ɛhye mɔ ɛnle mgbɔnwɔ kpalɛ. Yɛze ye zɔ ɔluakɛ mgbɔnwɔ ɛngola ɛnriandi wɔ amungu ne anu, ɔnle zɔ ɔ? Noko Baebolo ne ka anwuma mgbɔnwɔ nwo edwɛkɛ. Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɔka ye zɔ la ɔ?

Ɔka ye zɔ ɔluakɛ mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la ɛnee bɛfa mgbɔnwɔ bɛdi gyima dɔɔnwo wɔ konle nu. Yemɔti Baebolo ne ka menli mɔɔ dede mgbɔnwɔ zo bɛvi anwuma bɛlɛba aze la anwo edwɛkɛ fa kile kɛ Nyamenle ne menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la baho konle. Asoo ɛze ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbaho konle ɛhye la duma? Bɛfɛlɛ ye Amagɛdɔn. Zɔhane konle ne baye ɛtaneyɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti avi azɛlɛ ye azo.

Gyisɛse a le Ahenle ne mɔɔ bali bɛ nyunlu aho konle ɛhye wɔ Amagɛdɔn a. Kakye kɛ, Gyisɛse a le ahenle ne mɔɔ Gyihova kpale ye kɛ ɔli Ye arane ne azo belemgbunli a. Ɛhye ati a Gyisɛse zo belemgbunli abɔtile la. Na dadeɛ ne kile kɛ ɔbahu Nyamenle kpɔvolɛma kɔsɔɔti. Asoo ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsi yɛ nwo kɛ Nyamenle bazɛkye ɛtanevolɛma kɔsɔɔti la ɔ?

Sia ɛ nzi nea Ɛzukoalɛdeɛ 10 ne. Duzu a ɛnwu ye wɔ ɛkɛ ne a? Ɛhɛe, Azuyilɛ kpole ne mɔɔ zɛkyele ɛtanevolɛma la ɔ. Nwane a manle Azuyilɛ ne rale a? Gyihova Nyamenle ɔ. Akee nea Ɛzukoalɛdeɛ 15 ne. Duzu a ɛlɛkɔ zo wɔ ɛkɛ ne a? Senle mɔɔ vi Gyihova ɛkɛ ne la ɛlɛsɛkye Sodɔm nee Gomɔla.

Buke Ɛzukoalɛdeɛ 33 ne. Nea mɔɔ ɛlɛsi Yigyibitima mgbɔnwɔ nee konle ehwili ne mɔ anwo zo la. Nwane a manle nzule ne rahedale bɛ nwo zo a? Gyihova ɔ. Ɔyɛle ye zɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle ye menli ne anwo bane. Nea Ɛzukoalɛdeɛ 76 ne. Ɛbanwu ye wɔ ɛkɛ ne kɛ Gyihova manle bɛzɛkyele ye menli Yizilayɛma bɔbɔ, ɔlua bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ti.

Yemɔti, ɔnle kɛ ɔsi yɛ nwo kɛ Gyihova bazoa ye anwuma ɛlɔnema yeamaa bɛava azɛlɛ ye azo ɛtaneyɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛara awieleɛ a. Na dwenle mɔɔ zɔhane bahile la anwo nea! Buke mukelɛ ne anzi na maa yɛnlea.Yekile 16:16; 19:11-16. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuya

data.titulo: Paladaese Fofolɛ Wɔ Azɛlɛ Ye Azo
data.contenido:
NEA mbaka ndendenle, felawɔse ngɛnlɛma nee awoka mgbole ne mɔ. Asoo ɔmmaa ɛke ɛnyɛ ahomeka? Nea kɛzi weɛlɛ ne ɛlɛdi aleɛ wɔ kakula nrenya ne asa nu la. Na nea awenade ne mɔ nee mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ mɔɔ gyigyi ndile ne azo wɔ nehane la. Ɛnrɛhulo kɛ ɛkɛdɛnla ɛleka mɔɔ ɔle kɛ ɛke la ɔ?

Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ ɛtɛnla azɛlɛ ye azo dahuu wɔ paladaese bie anu. Na ɔmkpondɛ kɛ ɛnwu nyane nee amaneɛ mɔɔ menli nwu ye ɛnɛ la bie. Ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ Baebolo ne bɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbadɛnla paladaese fofolɛ ne anu la ɛne: ‘Nyamenle nee bɛ badɛnla. Ewule anzɛɛ ɛzunlɛ anzɛɛ nyane ɛnle ɛkɛ ne bieko. Alumua ninyɛne ne mɔ ɛze ɛhɔ.’ Gyisɛse banlea anwu ye kɛ nzenzaleɛ nwanwane ɛhye bara. Ɛze mekɛ ne ɔ? Ɔbayɛ zɔ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbaye ɛtaneyɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti nee ɛtanevolɛma yeavi azɛlɛ ye azo la. Kakye kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la ɔyɛle menli mɔɔ ewule ngakyile wɔ bɛ nwo la ayile, na ɔdwazole menli ɔvile ewule nu bɔbɔ. Gyisɛse yɛle ɛhye vale hilele mɔɔ ɔbayɛ ye wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo amuala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yerayɛ Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne azo Belemgbunli la.

Dwenle kɛzi azɛlɛ ye azo paladaese fofolɛ ne anu ɛdɛnlanlɛ bayɛ anyelielɛ la anwo nea! Gyisɛse nee menli mɔɔ ɔbakpa bɛ la bie mɔ, bali tumi wɔ anwuma. Menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ bali tumi la banlea kɛ awie biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la anye balie. Maa yɛnlea mɔɔ ɔhyia kɛ yɛyɛ amaa yɛanwu ye kɛ Nyamenle bamaa yɛanyia dahuu ngoane wɔ ye paladaese fofolɛ ne anu la.Yekile 21:3, 4; 5:9, 10; 14:1-⁠3. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ASOO ɛbahola wɔaha deɛ mɔɔ kakula raalɛ ekyi ne nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ ɛlɛkenga la? Ɛhɛe, buluku ɛhye mɔɔ ɛlɛkenga mɔɔ yemɔ a le Me Buluku Mɔɔ Ɔka Baebolo nu Edwɛkɛ la ala ɔ. Na bɛlɛkenga ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ ɛlɛkenga mɔɔ se “Kɛzi Yɛbahola Yɛadɛnla Aze Dahuu.”

Ɛze debie mɔɔ bɛlɛsukoa la ɔ? Mɔɔ lumua la a le kɛ saa yɛbadɛnla aze dahuu a ɔhyia kɛ yɛsukoa Gyihova nee ɔ Ra Gyisɛse anwo debie. Baebolo ne se: ‘Adenle ne mɔɔ maa bɛtɛnla aze dahuu la ɛne. Sukoa nɔhalɛ Nyamenle kokye ne nee Ralɛ ne mɔɔ ɔzoanle ye ɔrale azɛlɛ ye azo, mɔɔ yemɔ a le Gyisɛse Kelaese la anwo debie.’

Kɛzi yɛbahola yɛazukoa Gyihova Nyamenle nee ɔ Ra Gyisɛse anwo debie ɛ? Adenle ko a le kɛ yɛbakenga Me Buluku Mɔɔ Ɔka Baebolo nu Edwɛkɛ yɛavi ye mɔlebɛbo yɛahɔdwu ye awieleɛ. Ɔka Gyihova nee Gyisɛse anwo edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo, ɔnle zɔ ɔ? Eza ɔka ninyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛyɛ yɛɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɔ zo mɔɔ bɛbayɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ. Noko ɔhyia kɛ yɛyɛ dɔɔnwo yɛtɛla buluku ɛhye mɔɔ yɛkenga la ala.

Ɛnwu buluku ɛhendeɛ ne mɔɔ la azɛlɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne la ɔ? Baebolo ne ɔ. Maa awie ɛgenga Baebolo ne ɛleka mɔɔ bɛyele ɛzukoalɛdeɛ mɔɔ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu bɛvile la ɔhile wɔ. Baebolo ne maa yɛ sa ka edwɛkɛ muala mɔɔ hyia amaa yɛ muala yɛahola yɛazonle Gyihova wɔ adenle kpalɛ zo na yɛanyia dahuu ngoane la. Yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ yɛmaa ɔyɛ yɛ subane kɛ yɛbazukoa Baebolo ne fane dɔɔnwo.

Noko Gyihova Nyamenle nee Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo debie mɔɔ yɛsukoa ala la anzo. Yɛbahola yɛanyia bɛ ngilehilelɛ ne nee bɛ nwo ndelebɛbo dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, noko akee yɛnrɛnyia dahuu ngoane. Ɛze debie bieko mɔɔ nwolɛ hyia la ɔ?

Ɔhyia kɛ eza yɛbɔ yɛ ɛbɛla yɛmaa ɔ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ yɛsukoa la yɛ ko. Ɛkakye Dwudase Yesekaleɔto ɔ? Ɛnee ɔboka menli 12 ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse kpale bɛ yɛle bɛ ye ɛzoanvolɛma la anwo. Ɛnee Dwudase lɛ Gyihova nee Gyisɛse anwo ndelebɛbo dɔɔnwo. Noko duzu a dole ye a? Wɔ mekɛ bie anzi ɔrayɛle angomedi, na ɔyele Gyisɛse ɔmanle ye kpɔvolɛma ɔliele dwɛtɛ fufule 30. Yemɔti Dwudase ɛnrɛnyia dahuu ngoane.

Ɛkakye Gɛheezae, nrenya ne mɔɔ yɛzukoale ɔ nwo debie wɔ Ɛzukoalɛdeɛ 69 ne la ɔ? Ɔhulole kɛ ɔkɛnyia adɛladeɛ nee ezukoa mɔɔ ɛnle ye ɛdeɛ la. Yemɔti ɔbɔle adalɛ ɔliele ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ. Noko Gyihova deanle ye. Na ɔbadea yɛdayɛ noko saa yɛanli ye mɛla ne mɔ azo a.

Noko menli mgbalɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ zonlenle Gyihova nɔhalɛ nu dahuu a. Yɛkpondɛ kɛ yɛyɛ kɛ menli zɔhane la, ɔnle zɔ ɔ? Mɔɔ kakula Samoɛle yɛle la le neazo kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdi ɔ nzi a. Kɛmɔ yɛnwunle ye wɔ Ɛzukoalɛdeɛ 55 ne la, kakye kɛ, ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ nna anzɛɛ nnu ala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsonle Gyihova wɔ ye ɛdanlɛ sua ne anu la. Yemɔti ɔnvane nwolɛ kɛ ɛle kakula la, ɛnle kakula somaa mɔɔ ɛngola ɛnzonle Gyihova a.

Nɔhalɛ nu, sonla mɔɔ yɛ muala yɛkpondɛ kɛ yɛdi ɔ nzi la a le Gyisɛse Kelaese. Mekɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔle kakula, kɛmɔ yɛnwunle ye wɔ Ɛzukoalɛdeɛ 87 ne la, ɛnee ɔwɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu ɛkɛ ne ɔlɛka ye anwuma Selɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ yeahile awie mɔ. Bɛmaa yɛli ye neazo ne anzi. Bɛmaa yɛha Gyihova, yɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ anwo yɛ nwanwane nee ɔ Ra Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo edwɛkɛ yɛhile menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ yɛkɛhola la. Saa yɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ a, yɛɛ akee yɛbahola yɛadɛnla aze dahuu wɔ Nyamenle paladaese fofolɛ ne anu wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo a.Dwɔn 17:⁠3; Edwɛndolɛ 145:1-21. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia
